title: Item:Elixir of Mnemonic Enhancement

__NOTOC__ {{Top}} {{hatnote|See also [[Mnemonic Enhancer]] and [[Concentrated Elixir of Mnemonic Enhancement]]}} Consuming a mnemonic elixir restores consumed [[spell point]]s to your character. Additionally, it cures [[Feeblemind]]. Mnemonic Enhancement potency depends on the level of the quest.
